tool_calls.saw: From space, the site reads as a large open green area embedded in suburban Newark, Ohio, with the old golf course fairways still visible as lighter grass patches amid the tree cover. Now loading the LiDAR hillshade.

params.question: What earthwork shapes are visible? Can you see the octagon walls, the circle, and the connecting avenue?
params.title: Octagon Earthworks, LiDAR hillshade

tool_calls.saw: The LiDAR cuts straight through the suburban cover and draws the full form with striking clarity: the large octagonal enclosure with its eight walls and corner bastions sits to the right, the circle with Observatory Mound is to its left, and the connecting avenue runs between them, all invisible in true colour but unmistakable in the 1 m bare-earth model.
